blocks.text: Ammonia molecule nitrogen par lone pair ki wajah se pyramidal hai. Jab nitrogen atom yeh lone pair ammonium banane mein istemal karta hai to ion tetrahedral shakal ikhtiyar karta hai jis mein chaaron bonds lambai aur taqat mein barabar hain (Figure 12.2). Ammonium ion acid-base reaction se banta hai: lone pair acid se proton qubool karta hai. IUPAC ammonia ke liye azane aur ammonium ke liye azanium naam bhi tajweez karti hai, azote se, nitrogen ka Greek se nikla naam jis ka matlab 'be-jaan' hai, jo sodium azide NaN3 jaise mushtaqat ke naam mein istemal hota hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: ammonia, NH3, 3D andaaz mein; aik bond wedge (aap ki taraf) aur aik dashes (door); nitrogen ke oopar lone pair hai jis se molecule pyramid-numa hai. + H+ wala teer lone pair ko proton se judta dikhata hai. Daen: ammonium, NH4+, nitrogen ke gird chaar hydrogen tetrahedral shakal mein aur chaar barabar N-H bonds.
blocks.caption: Pyramid-numa ammonia aur tetrahedral ammonium (Figure 12.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Wazeh karein ke ammonium ion kaise banta hai aur us ki shakal ammonia se kyun mukhtalif hai (MCQ III).
blocks.explanation: Ammonia ke nitrogen par teen bonding pairs aur ek lone pair hain, jo ek doosre ko dhakel kar pyramid banate hain. Jab acid proton deta hai to lone pair us se bond banata hai, nitrogen ko bina lone pair ke chaar ek jaise bonding pairs dete hue; chaar barabar pairs baqaida tetrahedron mein phailte hain, to NH4+ tetrahedral hai.

items: NH3 pyramidal (lone pair); lone pair H+ le kar NH4+ deta hai, chaar barabar N-H bonds ke saath tetrahedral; IUPAC naam azane aur azanium.
